verdict.rationale: Square documents a Refunds API with 'Refund Payments' and 'Process an Unlinked Refund' guides, so issuing refunds via the API is a first-party capability. The evidence is only page titles: it never shows full versus partial refund amounts, and nothing covers refunding from the seller dashboard. Missing for 10: evidence of dashboard-based refunds, explicit documentation of partial vs full refund amounts, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
